content: For the case of crosslingual clustering, we introduce INLINEFORM0 , which has a similar definition to INLINEFORM1 , only instead of passing document/cluster similarity feature vectors, we pass cluster/cluster similarities, across all language pairs. Furthermore, the features are the crosslingual embedding vectors of the sections title, body and both combined (similarly to the monolingual case) and the timestamp features. For denoting the cluster timestamp, we use the average timestamps of all articles in it.
